invariants.rationale: The method returns the output of a static utility function and is expected to return a metadata object, never null under normal operation.
The return type of the method is HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, so the result must be an instance of HoodieWriteMetadata.
The primary data in HoodieWriteMetadata is expected in getWriteStatuses(), so it should not be null.
HoodieWriteMetadata parameterizes on List<WriteStatus>. getWriteStatuses() should return a List.
It is common for write status collections to avoid null entries.
